'''Herron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] along with his friend [[A'zabii]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] after they became embroiled in a brawl. The pair believed they had been cheated in a game of cards, and the resultant fight ended with the death of an Imperial operative and several others wounded; the Empire captured the pair and took them to their prison facility [[A-77 (prison)|A-77]], where A'zabii and Herron were interrogated as to their true identities. The duo resisted the Imperial interrogation, and maintained that they did not know of the operative's identity.<ref name="TOR" />
